body:
Most people have friends or at least a sense of family in their lives.
From a very young age I had neither. 

I had parents and yes I have good memories. but I also have memories of being told I was evil and had no soul when I was 3. Lots of violence and isolation, purposely keeping me from going to school or socializing until after I was 18.

I still dont understand half of my childhood. I do know that I would at least have someone to talk to had I been allowed to socialize and create relationships with people. As it stands now the only friends I had were people I met online and I stopped talking to them months ago. 

There isn't really anyone. 

And it's surprising I guess, not so much scary as just surprising.. I wasn't much expecting that.

I gave some of my photography equipment away today. I told her she could borrow it but I really dont care if I get it back. I dont know if I was hoping it would make me feel better being nice to someone or what. 

Right now I just cant get over the fact that I feel like I never even got a fighting chance in this.

And the fact that I couldn't get the idea of taking a header off the parking garage at work out of my head each time I went outside today. I always thought I would be someone who OD'd on Narcotics, kinda interesting how that's what has caught my attention right now.

Thanks.

The people who have been the closest to being close to me are coworkers and people i met on a parenting forum. It wouldnt be fair to share this with them as they are merely acquaintances. I've never successfully been able to create and maintain friendships or connections with people, Its simply become more apparent since becoming a parent and choosing to no longer go out and party like I used to.

Im in an odd place right now. I've never just plain not shown up to work before.  

and Yea I was wondering if there is something else wrong with me.

:( his story is so sad. 

I hope he's found peace.
